shared_prerequisite_rule: Replay every retained recipe using the declared causal source fallback; no shared coverage flag substitutes for an actual candidate replay.
intraday_requirement: KALCB carry_off must be flat by actual continuous-session end each day
activity_rule: Position-level trade counts remain diagnostics and existing score components; no binary minimum trade-count qualification. Economic/risk limits otherwise unchanged.
source_fallback: OLR excludes incomplete completed prefixes from current and prior sector features and candidates. KALCB blocks new entries after a missing completed interval and cancels unfilled flat entries. Observed execution bars remain unchanged. Gaps overlapping working orders or positions remain unverified.
kalcb_repair_rule: In listed order, replay the saved control at 1% and 0.5% execution participation. Choose the first policy with zero daily residual inventory, zero terminal positions and a valid execution/source audit in both. Short-circuit a failed policy. Ignore returns when choosing. Freeze that common overlay before comparing all 35 retained recipes. If no control policy passes, compare all recipes under the last declared overlay; no automatic promotion. Existing capital/leverage stay unchanged.
